question: Should OpenClaw accept `currentTokenCount` plus these SDK token-budget helpers as the stable public ContextEngine/plugin SDK contract now, or fold the token-budget signal into the broader assemble metadata RFC at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/82137?
rationale: The patch changes a public plugin API and SDK export surface that third-party context engines can compile against, while related public assemble metadata design remains open.

options.title: Accept Narrow Contract After Proof
options.body: Approve this focused field now, then require SDK baseline regeneration and redacted live long-session/context-engine proof before merge.

options.title: Fold Into Broader RFC
options.body: Pause this branch and handle token counts together with the broader provenance/internal-event assemble API design.

options.title: Keep Private For Now
options.body: Avoid exporting the helper surface until a maintainer-owned plugin API compatibility plan is settled.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Contract After Proof
recommendation.body: Approve this focused field now, then require SDK baseline regeneration and redacted live long-session/context-engine proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to this PR and have the most recent merged history on the exact context-engine budget and Codex projection paths.
